content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The recruitment is made on an outsourcing basis up to 31 March 2027, and thereafter services will be continued as per need and subject to satisfactory performance. For Psychosocial Counselor, the empaneled candidates shall be engaged on a call basis as and when their services are required.

rows.consolidated_pay_per_month: @ Rs. 500/- per session & atleast 200 visits in a year (on Call)

content_sections.heading: Age Limit and Relaxations
content_sections.text: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years, reckoned as on 01/07/2026. S.C's, S.T's & BC's: 5 (Five) years relaxation. Ex-service man: 3 (Three) years relaxation in addition to the length of service in armed forces. Disabled persons: 10 (ten) years relaxation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Narayanpet District Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form along with instructions from the official website of Narayanpet District ( Official Website ). Fill out the application form carefully with all required details. Enclose self-attested copies of all necessary certificates and documents. Submit the filled-in application form in person or through registered post to the O/o. the District Medical and Health Office, Narayanpet District between 12-10-2026 and 22-10-2026 (10:30 AM to 05:00 PM on working days).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSC or equivalent examination certificate Intermediate or 10+2 examination certificate Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks memos of all the years (qualifying examination) Registration certificates of Board of Indian Medicine (for AYUSH Medical Officer Post) Registration certificate of the Telangana Pharmacy Council (for Pharmacist post) Latest Caste Certificates issued by the Tahsildar / MRO concerned Study certificate for the years from 4th Class to 10th class and in case of Private Study, residency certificate from the Tahsildar / MRO concerned PH certificate in respect of candidates claiming reservation under PH Quota Relevant certificates in respect of candidates claiming Ex-service man quota 1 Photograph duly pasted on the application form Acknowledgment card

faq.question: Q1. Is this job permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The recruitment is made on an outsourcing basis up to 31 March 2027. Thereafter, services will be continued as per need and subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q2. Who gets a relaxation in age and how much?
faq.answer: Upper age relaxations are granted as follows: 5 years for S.C's, S.T's & BC's; 3 years in addition to service length for ex-servicemen; and 10 years for disabled persons.

faq.question: Q3. Which documents need to be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose self-attested copies of their SSC certificate, Intermediate certificate, qualifying examination pass certificate and marks memos, council/board registration certificates (where applicable), latest caste certificate, study/residence certificates from 4th to 10th class, PH/ex-service man certificates if applicable, 1 photograph pasted on the form, and an acknowledgment card.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled-in application form is 22 October 2026 by 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection criteria for these posts?
faq.answer: For AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacists, Dieticians, Psychosocial Counselor and Yoga Professional, 90 marks are allotted based on qualifying examination marks and 10 marks for age weightage (0.5 mark per completed year of age from 18 years, up to 10 marks). For Multi-Purpose Worker (MPW), 90 marks are allotted for a written test conducted by authorities and 10 marks for age weightage.
